magi.definition:
n (New Testament) the sages who visited Jesus and Mary and Joseph shortly after Jesus was born; the Gospel According to Matthew says they were guided by a star and brought gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh; because there were three gifts it is usually assumed that there were three of them
n a magician or sorcerer of ancient times
n a member of the Zoroastrian priesthood of the ancient Persians
magi.translation: n. 多阵γ线照射器（Multi-Array Gamma Irradiator）

magian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the Magi.
n. One of the Magi, or priests of the Zoroastrian religion in
   Persia; an adherent of the Zoroastrian religion.
magian.translation:
n. 魔术师, 古波斯之祭司
a. 拜火教祭司的

magians.definition:
plural of Magian
a. Of or pertaining to the Magi.
n. One of the Magi, or priests of the Zoroastrian religion in
   Persia; an adherent of the Zoroastrian religion.
magians.translation:
(Magian 的复数) n.魔术师, 古波斯之祭司
a. 拜火教祭司的

magic.definition: n. any art that invokes supernatural powers
magic.translation:
n. 魔术, 魔法
a. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的

magic bullet.translation: n. [医]魔术弹; 妙招; 灵丹妙药

magic hand.translation:
[计] 机械手

magic ink.translation: [化] 万能笔(可在油污金属表面划记号)

magic mushroom.translation: n. （食用后会产生幻觉的）神奇蘑菇, 致幻蘑菇

magic nucleus.translation: [化] 幻核(质子数或中子数为幻数的核)

magic realism.translation: n. 魔幻现实主义（指亦幻亦实的写作或绘画手法创作的）

magic spell.translation: [网络] 魔咒；咒语；魔法效果

magic square.translation: [计] 幻方, 魔方, 纵横图

magic trick.translation: [网络] 魔术；魔术戏法；魔术技巧

magical.definition: s possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers
magical.translation: a. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的

magically.translation: adv. 用魔法地；如魔法般地

magician.definition: n. someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience
magician.translation: n. 魔术家, 幻术家, 术士

magicians.definition:
n. someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience
n. one who practices magic or sorcery

magicking.translation: v. 用魔法变出（magic的现在分词形式）

magics.definition:
n. any art that invokes supernatural powers
n. an illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers
magics.translation: v. 用魔法变出（magic的第三人称单数形式）

magicube.translation: n. [摄](内藏机械点火器的)魔方闪光灯

magid.translation: abbr. magnetic intrusion detector 磁侵入检测器

magilp.definition: n a medium for oil-paints; linseed oil mixed with mastic varnish or turpentine
magilp.translation: n. 油画用的油, 似冻子之油画材料

maginn.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 马金 McGinn的变体

maginot.definition: n. French politician who proposed the Maginot Line (1877-1932)
maginot.translation: 马其诺(Andre, 1877-1932, 法国政治家, 曾于1922-1931期间4次出任法国陆军部长)

magis.translation: abbr. marine air-ground intelligence system 海军陆战队空-地情报系统; megawatt air-to-ground illumination system 兆瓦级空-地照明系统

magister.definition:
n. Master; sir; -- a title of the Middle Ages, given to a
   person in authority, or to one having a license from a university to
   teach philosophy and the liberal arts.
magister.translation: 古罗马或中世纪的教师

magisterial.definition: a. of or relating to a magistrate
magisterial.translation:
a. 长官的, 威严的, 有权威的
[法] 长官的, 有权威的, 专横的

magisterially.definition:
r in an overbearingly domineering manner; as a dictator
r in an authoritative and magisterial manner

magisterialness.definition: n. The quality or state of being magisterial.

magisters.definition:
plural of magister
n. Master; sir; -- a title of the Middle Ages, given to a
   person in authority, or to one having a license from a university to
   teach philosophy and the liberal arts.
magisters.translation: (magister 的复数) 古罗马或中世纪的教师

magistery.definition:
n. Mastery; powerful medical influence; renowned efficacy;
   a sovereign remedy.
n. A magisterial injunction.
n. A precipitate; a fine substance deposited by
   precipitation; -- applied in old chemistry to certain white
   precipitates from metallic solutions; as, magistery of bismuth.
magistery.translation: [医] 沉淀物, 精巧制剂

magistery of bismuth.translation:
[化] 硝酸二羟铋和二硝酸羟铋混合物
[医] 硷式硝酸铋, 次硝酸铋

magistracies.translation: n. 地方行政官, 执法官, 地方行政官员的职位( magistracy的名词复数 )

magistracy.translation:
n. 长官的职位, 地方行政长官
[法] 裁判司署, 地方法庭

magistral.definition:
a. Pertaining to a master; magisterial; authoritative;
   dogmatic.
a. Commanded or prescribed by a magister, esp. by a doctor;
   hence, effectual; sovereign; as, a magistral sirup.
a. Formulated extemporaneously, or for a special case; --
   opposed to officinal, and said of prescriptions and medicines.
n. A sovereign medicine or remedy.
n. A magistral line.
n. Powdered copper pyrites used in the amalgamation of ores
   of silver, as at the Spanish mines of Mexico and South America.
magistral.translation:
a. 教师的, 长官的, 主要的
[医] 按方配制的

magistrand.translation: 研究生(苏格兰大学攻读文科硕士学位的学生)

magistrate.definition: n. a lay judge or civil authority who administers the law (especially one who conducts a court dealing with minor offenses)
magistrate.translation:
n. 长官, 法官, 推事
[法] 司法行政官, 治安法官, 地方法官

magistrate's court.translation: [法] 治安法官, 司法行政官法庭, 地方法院

magistrates.definition: n. a lay judge or civil authority who administers the law (especially one who conducts a court dealing with minor offenses)
magistrates.translation: n. 地方法官, 治安官( magistrate的复数形式 )

magistrateship.translation: n. 地方行政官的职位, 地方法官的职位, 地方法官的任期, 地方行政官的任期

magistratical.definition:
a. Of, pertaining to, or proceeding from, a magistrate;
   having the authority of a magistrate.

magistrature.translation: n. 长官的职位, 地方行政长官
